body: Boeing 787-9 operators are moving their business class cabins from a 2-2-2 layout to a 1-2-1 layout, a shift driven by passenger expectations for privacy, direct aisle access and comfort. In the older 2-2-2 arrangement, some passengers had to climb over their seatmates to reach the aisle, leaving travelers feeling cramped and short of privacy. With 1-2-1, every seat has direct aisle access, and the layout allows wider seats, more room to stretch out, privacy screens and lie-flat beds.

Qatar Airways set a benchmark with its Qsuite, a 1-2-1 product widely praised for its design, and United Airlines and Air New Zealand have followed by upgrading their 787-9 fleets to similar configurations. Airlines that offer a superior business class product are more likely to attract high-paying customers, which matters for profitability on long-haul routes, and as more carriers adopt 1-2-1, those keeping the older layout risk falling behind.

The 1-2-1 layout typically uses a staggered arrangement in which each passenger has a pod with a lie-flat bed, direct aisle access and storage space, often with larger entertainment screens, improved lighting and more advanced seat controls. Several factors are driving the shift now: younger travelers entering business travel expect more comfort and technology, competition from low-cost carriers and expanding premium services is pushing traditional airlines to innovate, and advances in aircraft design have made the configuration easier to implement on the 787-9's spacious cabin. Airlines are investing heavily in premium products as business class remains a key revenue driver, and direct aisle access and personal space are increasingly becoming the expected standard.
en.summary: Boeing 787-9 operators are shifting business class from 2-2-2 to 1-2-1 layouts, giving every passenger direct aisle access, wider seats and more privacy, led by Qatar Airways' Qsuite and followed by United and Air New Zealand.
en.title: Why Boeing 787-9 operators are moving to 1-2-1 business class

body: 波音787-9營運商正將商務艙從2-2-2配置改為1-2-1配置，背後是旅客對隱私、直通走道與舒適度的期待。舊式2-2-2配置下，部分旅客必須跨越鄰座才能前往走道，常讓人感到擁擠、缺乏隱私；1-2-1配置讓每個座位都能直通走道，座椅更寬、伸展空間更大，並搭配隱私隔板與平躺座椅。
卡達航空以1-2-1配置的Qsuite樹立標竿，設計廣受好評；聯合航空與紐西蘭航空也跟進，將787-9機隊升級為類似配置。商務艙產品更出色的航空公司，更容易吸引高消費旅客，對長程航線獲利至關重要；隨著更多業者採用1-2-1，仍沿用舊配置的業者可能落後。

1-2-1配置通常採交錯排列，每位旅客擁有獨立包廂，附平躺座椅、直通走道與置物空間，常見配備還包括更大的娛樂螢幕、更佳的照明與更先進的座椅控制。推動這波轉變的因素包括：年輕商務旅客對舒適度與科技的期待更高、低成本航空崛起與高階服務擴張帶來的競爭壓力，以及飛機設計進步讓787-9寬敞的客艙更容易導入這類配置。航空公司正大力投資高階產品，商務艙仍是重要的收入來源，直通走道與個人空間正逐漸成為旅客期待的標準。
zh.summary: 波音787-9營運商正把商務艙從2-2-2改為1-2-1配置，每位旅客都能直通走道、座椅更寬也更有隱私，卡達航空Qsuite帶頭，聯合航空與紐西蘭航空跟進。
